extension.summary: Free live TV from around the world
extension.description: Fetches free public live TV playlists from the iptv-org project, cleans them up and configures PVR IPTV Simple Client automatically. Pick any country in the settings. Not affiliated with iptv-org.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on only links to publicly available streams and hosts no content.
extension.news: v0.2.0 - Test channels now (hides dead streams), debug log + export, diagnostics.
